standaloneRustConsumer: passed with the romedb-production profile; 335 registry/git package identities match the workspace lockfile
upgradeRestore: Passed from the 0.2.13 to 0.2.20 packages on Node 22.0.0 and 24.19.0 (groups v0213-upgrade-restore to v0220-upgrade-restore). 0.2.13 is the floor: it changed the stored value prefix, and earlier files are refused. A collection with a weighted full-text index uses catalog version 9, which 0.2.20 and earlier refuse.

engine.exceptions: the maintained engine exceptions retained, one added: FTS single-word prefixes (romedb/docs/core-exceptions.md)
engine.storageFormat: __romedb_ schema prefix, .romedb extension, stored values prefixed RDB 01 (FDB 01 before 0.2.13); openEmbedded and serve use MVCC files; collections with a * array path index use catalog version 8, others keep version 7 or earlier; collections with a weighted full-text index use catalog version 9
engine.change: one engine core patch: core/index_method/fts/prefix.rs expands a one-word prefix (hel*) into the 64 indexed words that start with it and are in the most documents, before Tantivy builds the query; a query without a prefix builds as before. Field weights use the engine weights option, and search::snippet is a frontend helper. Same upstream as 0.2.20 (Turso v0.8.3, Tantivy 0.27.0)

spatial.explainReadsNoData: metered EXPLAIN reports zero rows read for every spatial form (spatial_explain_reads_no_documents_or_index_entries)

supportedScope.ownership: One owning process per database file; shared clients connect to its service

performance: Historical 2.1.0 operating envelope retained; fresh bounded application sample, not capacity guarantees
